findings.reason: The protected solution is concise, conventional, and interview-ready. The names minimum_cost, used_bikes, worker_index, bike_index, bike_bit, distance, and best expose the cached subproblem, assignment mask, next worker, candidate bike, transition, and minimum objective directly. Its index names are semantic compounds, and there is no exact generic local named index.

A used_bikes mask uniquely describes which bikes have been assigned, and its set-bit count equals the next worker because workers are processed in fixed index order. Every transition chooses one clear bike bit, adds exactly that worker-bike Manhattan distance, and recurses on a mask with one additional distinct bike. The base case after W selected bikes contributes zero. Thus every recurrence path is a valid one-to-one assignment and every valid assignment appears among the choices. Taking the minimum transition plus the optimal cached suffix proves global minimum total cost; B >= W guarantees a finite choice before the base case.

Metadata consistently identifies Premium LeetCode problem 1066, Python, and the native assignBikes(workers, bikes) interface. Authenticated source evidence confirms 1 <= n <= m <= 10, two coordinates per location, coordinate values from 0 through 999, and uniqueness across all worker and bike locations. The app-local solve adapter preserves exactly one distinct bike per worker, optional unused surplus bikes, Manhattan-distance summation, global minimum rather than greedy assignment, and the integer return contract.

The protected app source and immutable native source bound to verified submission 2067478383 are algorithmically identical: both memoize by the same used-bike mask, derive the same next worker from bit count, enumerate the same clear bike bits, compute the same Manhattan distances, minimize the same recursive transitions, and terminate after all workers are assigned. Their only structural differences are the required Solution.assignBikes wrapper, native typing syntax, and harmless expression formatting.

The three hidden workloads grow equal worker and bike counts from 2 through 6, representing 4 through 64 bike masks. Symmetric one-unit assignments make many distinct prefixes reach identical masks, so memoization solves each state once while factorial enumeration revisits suffixes across permutations. The exact protected source passed all eleven visible correctness cases and all three performance tiers with relative growth exponent -0.01 and a 0.99x largest runtime ratio. An independently correct permutation enumerator, using a min-cost-flow fallback only above the six-worker benchmark ceiling to keep the legal ten-worker correctness boundary below the safety cap, matched every correctness and benchmark output but failed only the calibrated complexity verdict at +0.91 and 8.14x, distinguishing O(B2^B) memoized state transitions from factorial enumeration.

The Approach accurately derives the used-bike mask, next-worker bit-count identity, unused-bike transitions, zero-cost base case, overlapping-suffix memoization, and global-optimum recurrence. Its edge cases cover surplus bikes, one worker, equal optima, zero distance, and greedy failure. The O(B2^B) time and O(2^B) auxiliary-space claims match the protected implementation and branch manifest.

The modular Reference preserves worker and bike coordinates, distinct one-to-one assignment, allowed unused bikes, the Manhattan-distance definition, total-cost minimization, all three source examples in order, explanations only for the first two, all seven constraints, and the bitmask-DP hint. It restores the live five-worker vertical-boundary Example 3 and labels the useful singleton separately under Additional Examples. Two accessible coordinate tables preserve every entity label and position from the source's two coordinate plots.

The authenticated live Premium statement directly verified exactly three examples in source order with exact inputs and outputs, explanations for only the first two examples, the five-worker third boundary example, seven constraints, one bitmask-DP hint, and two coordinate-plot images. source_fidelity.json binds those facts and every composed local section to the reviewed statement hash 6522c039a04db2674e4554f102dbceaf8fec43cfda251b4a391fbb7e628f663e.

coverage: The authenticated Premium statement contains exactly three examples. Their exact inputs and outputs now appear first in source order; the former incorrect third sample is retained accurately as an additional singleton trial, and the live five-worker vertical-boundary example is restored as sample-3.

All eleven ordinary correctness cases are visible samples or trials. They cover the endpoints n = 1 and n = m = 10, both equal and surplus bike counts, two-coordinate locations, coordinate values 0 and 999, and uniqueness across every worker and bike position.

Material behavior includes one-to-one assignment, unused surplus bikes, multiple equally optimal assignments, independent nearest choices, a genuine counterexample to worker-order greedy selection, rectangular assignment, interacting choices, and globally minimal Manhattan-distance summation.

An independent successive-shortest-path min-cost-flow oracle models source-to-worker, worker-to-bike, and bike-to-sink unit-capacity edges and recomputes every expected result without using a bike mask or the protected recurrence.

The oracle, protected app source, and immutable native Solution agreed on all 14 authored correctness-plus-benchmark inputs, 2310 exhaustive ordered assignments over a six-location grid with globally unique positions, 5000 deterministic random legal databases, and four explicit boundary databases. A factorial permutation control with an independent min-cost-flow fallback only above six workers also matched all 14 authored outputs.

The 4-, 16-, and 64-mask-state workloads remain hidden and performance-only, use size consistently as the number of possible bike masks, and span 16x. Every benchmark follows the factorial path; the correct control failed only scaling at +0.91 and 8.14x, while the O(B2^B) protected source passed at -0.01 and 0.99x.
